technique_name: Design a room with a beach theme.
description: The design of the room is influenced by beach elements. The walls are painted with a light blue color, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and relaxation. Large windows or glass paneling allow for plenty of natural light to enter the room, giving it an airy feel. The bed is a replica of a boat, with white-painted wood and blue accents to emphasize the beachy theme.
